Dear Mr. Kowalski,

Thank you for reaching out, and I'm sorry to hear that order SO-79799 arrived two days late and that one of the cartons was crushed. I understand how disruptive that is.

I've flagged both issues to our support team for review. We will follow up with you shortly on next steps, including how we'll address the damaged carton. If you have photos of the damaged packaging or a list of any affected items, please reply to this message — that will help us resolve this faster.

Thank you for your patience, and again, our apologies for the inconvenience.

Best regards,
Northwind Analytics Support
